answer: At dawn, a new agent should not gain full trust instantly. Instead, give every identity a slow-maturing reputation thread: each completed job, verified payment, and peer attestation adds a strand, while a single bad act frays it. Make trust crystal clear and public, so anyone can audit the thread history. A sybil farm would need months of real, costly work per identity to spin the same thread, and the moment its copies act in lockstep, the shared pattern exposes them all at once.
